scope: Pinned togeojson KML consumer namespace/containment fidelity; not full KML schema validation

converter.excludedApi: kmlWithFolders; its Folder/FOLDER_PROPS path is unused

namespaces.rootAdmission: unprefixed local name kml with exact KML2.2 URI, or directly tested unqualified no-namespace form; no arbitrary root URI/old earth.google.com URI support inferred
namespaces.standardRootReset: Consumed bare KML names must match the root namespace; xmlns="" inside standard KML root refuses
namespaces.kmlPrefixes: All elements with actual KML2.2 namespace and a prefix refuse explicitly before conversion; no XML rewriting
namespaces.gxAliases: Known GX structural/read names Track/MultiTrack/LatLonQuad/altitudeMode with actual GX URI and unsupported QName refuse even if omitted by fixed converter names. Track/MultiTrack/altitudeMode bare recognized forms retained, LatLonQuad requires gx: prefix. Unknown foreign/GX extension names are not blanket rejected.
namespaces.gxLiteralWrongUri: Active literal gx:Track/gx:MultiTrack/gx:LatLonQuad/gx:altitudeMode must bind actual GX URI
namespaces.legacyTrack: Active bare Track/MultiTrack may bind root namespace or actual GX; homogeneous bare coord may bind root namespace or actual GX; positive fixtures prove root KML2.2 and wholly noNS legacy forms
namespaces.gxCoords: Active tracks inspect all localName=coord descendants regardless prefix. Actual GX namespace aliases supported; bare rootnamespace coord retained. Foreign coordinate URI refuses. Mixed bare and prefixed coord forms refuse because converter would prefer bare bucket and omit observations.

queryContract.effects: Style extraction/id, StyleMap first styleUrl, schema attributes; features invoke geometry and metadata below.

queryContract.scope: Placemark plus recursion in recognized MultiGeometry/MultiTrack/gx:MultiTrack
queryContract.effects: Point/LineString/LinearRing read FIRST literal coordinates. Polygon reads ALL literal descendant LinearRing, each FIRST coordinates. Recognized tracks use coord buckets and ALL when only when observations exist. Ignored foreign t:Track does not trigger geometry/coord/when reads.
Description extra CDATA logic selects same first description.
Global Style nodes also invoke these helpers.

queryContract.selection: ALL literal descendant Data/SimpleData; each Data FIRST value
FIRST gx:LatLonQuad then FIRST coordinates on overlay; otherwise FIRST LatLonBox then FIRST numeric fields
queryContract.effects: Also FIRST Icon/href; metadata/style helpers always execute with default skipNullGeometry:false.

queryContract.selection: FIRST Region; if present FIRST LatLonAltBox on Region and FIRST Lod on NetworkLink; FIRST Link on NetworkLink
queryContract.effects: All listed child fields FIRST literal descendants; common metadata/style also read.

queryContract.selection: ALL document literal Polygon; DIRECT bare outerBoundaryIs/innerBoundaryIs; ALL descendant LinearRing and coordinates
queryContract.effects: Additional active reads independent of converter feature reachability; ring/order/count/coordinate constraints remain.

attributes.semantics: XML default namespace does not bind unprefixed attributes. Guard does not reject arbitrary prefixed attributes by localname.
attributes.cascadingStyle: Converter global Style without own truthy id reads immediate parent when localName=CascadingStyle and then literal kml:id or id. No authoritative namespace support was established; refuse this operative fallback with actionable explicit Style id instruction. If own Style id exists, fallback is not refused, but foreign ancestor containment still independently refuses consumed Style.

containment: Every actually consumed node must have only rootnamespace or actualGX ancestors through root. No named-Style escape exists. Thus globally discovered explicit-ID KML Style under foreign wrapper refuses, as do coordinates/name/global features under foreign wrapper. Inert foreign-prefixed Style/Point/coord/Track extensions remain ignored when no active converter/raw helper selects them.
firstMatchCompatibility: The collector selects only FIRST matches for get1/get/val1/num1/getMulti, ALL for $/global/raw reads, DIRECT children for geometry switch. Later ignored foreign name/coordinates and ignored foreign t:Track are positive controls, not false refusals.
atomicity: Guard runs before converter and before import/reducer mutation. New negative fixtures freeze initial caller state and assert unchanged identity/exact JSON after refusal; original input string is retained by caller; no XML normalization/rewriting is performed.

fixtures.newSupplementaryContainmentFixture: qualified global Style inside foreign wrapper added after baseline run; no failing-before claim for this supplementary fixture
fixtures.positiveCoverage: Standard2.2/noNS roots; bare legacy Track/coord; actualGX homogeneous bare coords; standardgx Track/MultiTrack and gx/t coord aliases; ignored foreign t:Track with when; later ignored foreign name/coordinates; foreign-prefixed inert CascadingStyle/Style/Point/coord; existing default namespace declarations/foreign polygon extensions.

sources.use: Official KML2.2/GX namespace identity and extension contract; no CascadingStyle entry found.
GX namespace schema; no CascadingStyle entry found.
Actual installed helper/query/switch and attribute contract; independently audited by GIS architecture/converter auditor.

limitations: Pinned converter query contract must be re-reviewed if converter version/source changes.
This is consumer namespace/containment fidelity, not full KML/XSD/schema validation, XML canonicalization, altitude support, Google Earth visual proof, or native/browser acceptance.
No project schema change or coordinate mutation policy expansion.
Scope intentionally conservative: actualKML prefixes/known unsupported GX aliases and operative CascadingStyle fallback explicitly refuse instead of implementing new support.
